name: matched-ks3-all-output-lr1
hypothesis: Reduce only active KS3 feedforward output-projection per-matrix learning-rate factors from the inherited2x to1x, retaining input-projection factors1x and original shape-based LR multipliers. Earlier uniform projection-rate changes altered both matrices together; this isolates input/output adaptation balance for learned nonlinear charts. Both dense and routed KS3 output matrices change. Retained conventional MLP branches keep original2x factors in hybrids. Keep geometry Adam[.9,.99] at0.125, zero coefficient initialization, width1024/rank one, BF16/GS32, ANVIL/masterweight/cache algorithms, MoE8top1, attention/head/embedding/router parameters and all shared/model-wide settings fixed. Weight-decay coefficients remain unchanged; the original ANVIL equations retain their existing coupling to effective matrix learning rates.
